overloadMerges.note: Output parameters are documented and arrow-marked ('←') as values filled in by the command, not inputs, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in based on syntax position alone; discriminatedBy/semanticRole also added to distinguish this overload from its Variable-addressed sibling.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills info with the current print-related value selected by selector for the list box (meaningful only during a Print object print job), addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag).

overloadMerges.note: Output parameters are documented and arrow-marked ('←') as values filled in by the command, not inputs, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in based on syntax position alone; discriminatedBy/semanticRole also added to distinguish this overload from its object-name-addressed sibling.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills info with the current print-related value selected by selector for the list box (meaningful only during a Print object print job), addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
